---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new adapter, tool, deployment recipe, or document — anything that is not a change to a published spec
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do that this project does not help you do today? Please
describe the real situation — the country, the agency, the incident type, the
platforms involved — as much as you can share.

## The proposed change

What would you like to see added, and roughly how would it work?

## Alternatives you have considered

Other ways to solve the same problem. It is fine to say "none".

## Who this helps

Which kinds of adopters would benefit — Caribbean NEMAs, Pacific island NGOs,
mutual-aid networks, satellite-messenger users, someone else?

## Would you help build it?

- [ ] I can write code / docs for this
- [ ] I can test it during development
- [ ] I can review a draft
- [ ] I am asking someone else to build it

None of these are required — the question is just so we know.

---

**Note:** if your request is a change to a published specification (the message
schema, the parser grammar, the AI-teammate protocol, or the transport
adapter contract), please use the **Spec change proposal** template instead.
